description:
Hushfacebook v0.2.0 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

New in 0.2.0: install the official Messenger beside a patched Facebook, no more update prompts, your phone's own font and emoji, and an option to stop sending your reel watch history. Long-press the Facebook logo to open Hushfacebook's settings.

There are 27 patches in all. Sponsored and suggested posts leave the news feed without a gap, and ads are gone from Stories and Reels. Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and sending ad telemetry. Links open in your browser and media can be saved. There's an AMOLED black theme and a Material You one.

Validation: 575 runtime tests passed locally. All 273 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 27 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72; the only manifest change is the two renamed Meta permissions.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

patches.name: AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black instead of dark grey. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.

patches.name: Block ad telemetry
patches.description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install for ad attribution.

patches.name: Block background ad prefetch
patches.description: Stops Facebook downloading ads and its ad model in the background. That saves data and battery. The ads don't take up storage either.

patches.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches.description: Keeps your feed position when you return to Facebook within ten minutes. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still work.

patches.name: Block promotional notifications
patches.description: Keeps the kinds of notification you pick off your phone, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays. Each kind has its own switch, and they all start off. Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions and login alerts always come through.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides the Follow button on reels and the comment and reaction previews under them. Buttons such as Remix, Use template, Add yours and Stars go too, and each part has its own switch.

patches.name: Default comment order
patches.description: Opens comments in the order you choose in Hushfacebook's settings, Most relevant, Newest or All comments, instead of the one Facebook picks. An order you pick in a post's comments stays for that post, and links to a comment still open on it.

patches.name: Disable Audience Network
patches.description: Stops Facebook serving ads to other apps. Those apps then show their own ads or none, and rewarded ads can fail.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops sending Facebook the list of reels you've watched. It's used to rank your Reels feed, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back in the feed.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed and in Watch, below Facebook's own items. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches.description: Removes feed posts that Facebook's own detection marked as made with AI, and the reels and Watch videos it flagged the same way. A third switch also removes posts their creator labelled as AI. Every switch starts off, so turn them on in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches.name: Hide Menu promotions
patches.description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections of Facebook's Menu. Each has its own switch. Settings, Help and support, your shortcuts and the rest of the Menu stay.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI in search
patches.description: Removes the Meta AI answer and the Ask Meta AI prompts Facebook adds to search results, and stops search suggestions from opening Meta AI by themselves. People, groups, pages and posts stay, and the Meta AI button still works.

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of reels between posts in the news feed, and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends. A reel a friend posts stays.

patches.name: Hide Stories tray
patches.description: Removes the row of stories at the top of the news feed, Create story included.

patches.name: Hide posts by words
patches.description: Hides feed posts whose text has a word or phrase you list, unless it also has one from your keep list. Hushfacebook never sends your words anywhere. The switch starts off, so turn it on and add words in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches.description: Removes the ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed. Hushfacebook asks Facebook not to send them, and the requests that fetch only ads don't go out. The listings people post stay.

patches.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind.

patches.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches.description: Removes the ads between the posts on someone's profile or a Page. The profile's own posts stay.

patches.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over a reel and ads inside a video.

patches.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, the sponsored posts and ad cards between the people, pages and posts you searched for.

patches.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories only shows stories people posted.

patches.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches.description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads: "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know", suggested groups, "Stories you might like", "Pages you may like" and its own upsells. In-feed surveys go too, and so does the "People you may know" row on your own profile. Each kind has its own switch.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes the stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, the ones marked Suggested in the Stories tray. Your friends' stories, the Pages you follow and Create story stay.

patches.name: Hide the Get Messenger card
patches.description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats while Messenger is installed. Facebook only counts a Messenger signed with its own key, so a re-signed Facebook shows the card even with Messenger right there. Without Messenger the card stays.

patches.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy. The logo long press and the launcher shortcut still open the settings too.

patches.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook. Long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed, or Facebook's launcher icon, to turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install beside the patched Facebook. Facebook shares two permissions with them, and Android lets only one signing key own a permission, so this patch renames Facebook's. A Root Mount install doesn't need it.

patches.name: Marketplace only
patches.description: Leaves only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu in the tab bar, and opens Facebook on Marketplace. Home with the news feed, Video, Friends, Feeds, Groups, Gaming and Events go. Notifications and links still open where they lead.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Gives Facebook's dark mode the colours of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue palette on Android 11. Light mode stays as it is. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of Facebook's in-app browser, without Facebook's click tracker or the fbclid tag it adds. Facebook pages still open in the app.

patches.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick in Hushfacebook's settings when you start it from its icon. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Notifications and links still open where they lead.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Makes profiles and some Settings pages open again on a re-signed build. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags, such as mibextid, off the links you share or copy. The post or reel a link opens stays the same. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace it back to you.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each Story on screen until you tap or swipe. Turn the switch off for Facebook's timing.

patches.name: Stop update prompts
patches.description: Stops Facebook's own update prompts on a patched build, which can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update promotions and the push message that has it look for an update go, and so do chat promotions aimed at older versions.

patches.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments. Typing @ still brings up the list. Photo tags and your text aren't touched.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves. A tap plays as usual. While its switch is on, Facebook's own Autoplay setting reads Off.

patches.name: Use the phone's emoji
patches.description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so the ones in posts, comments and chats look like the ones on your keyboard, big chat emoji included. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Restart Facebook after changing the switch.

patches.name: Use the system font
patches.description: Draws Facebook's own text in your phone's font instead of Meta's Optimistic typeface, or in a TrueType or OpenType file you pick in Hushfacebook's settings. Icons and emoji keep their fonts, and so does the text you put on a story. Restart Facebook after changing the font.

release_notes:
Hushfacebook 0.2.0 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74, and 577.0.0.50.72 still works. It's the batch of fixes held back since 0.1.8, with 27 patches now, five of them new.

New patches:

- **Install beside Meta's apps** (on by default). The official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace can now be installed next to a patched Facebook without `INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION`. If you patched before, patch again and install over the top. It's an ordinary update and Facebook keeps its data.
- **Stop update prompts** (on by default). A patched Facebook can't install Meta's updates, so it stops asking.
- **Use the system font** and **Use the phone's emoji** (both off until you pick them in Manager) draw Facebook's text and emoji with your phone's own fonts.
- **Don't send reel watch history** (off until you pick it) keeps the list of reels you watch from going back to Facebook.

Other changes:

- Long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed to open Hushfacebook's settings (#2). A tap still does what it always did.
- Hide AI-detected posts has a second switch for Reels and Watch.
- The Video file name setting takes `{owner}` and `{posted}`, so `{owner}_{posted}` saves a video as `Some Page_20260925.mp4` (#6).
- An opt-in check tells you when a new Hushfacebook release is out. It's off by default and never downloads anything.
- The settings screen shows which rows open something, and the diagnostic report choices fit at large text sizes.
- The README has a Troubleshooting section for Manager's error messages and a section on what Meta can see.

The full list is in CHANGELOG.md.

Checked on a signed-in test phone (Galaxy S22, Android 16) through Morphe Manager, installed over the top with the login kept: a long press on the Facebook logo opened the settings, a tap stayed Facebook's, and the Stories tray row reads as it should.

All 27 patches applied without force to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72. The only manifest change is the two renamed Meta permissions from Install beside Meta's apps. Local checks passed: 575 extension tests, 273 patch tests and both Android lints.

Requires Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a (240-640dpi) (Android 11+) Facebook bundle from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's signing key when you update.
